arguments.Title: Read turnaround status
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using System.IO; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { var c=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(); if(c==null){result.Log("NO_CLIENT");return;} File.WriteAllText("artifacts/high_speed_drive/turn-current-observation.json",c.LatestObservationJson); result.Log("status="+c.Status+" reason="+c.DiagnosticReason+" mission="+c.MissionResult+" target="+c.LastTargetSpeedKmh); } }
